description: Supplementary property annotations for the Soong module type schema. Provides module-reference and enum metadata that is not yet derivable from struct tags.

module_references.description: Properties whose values are module names (dependency references). These are string or string_list properties that should offer module-name completions, not file-path completions.

defaults.description: Defaults modules to inherit properties from.

required.description: Modules to install alongside this module.

host_required.description: Host modules to install when this module is installed on device.

target_required.description: Target modules to install when this module is installed on host.

static_libs.description: Modules to link or compile statically.

header_libs.description: Modules providing headers only (no compiled output).

whole_static_libs.description: Static libraries whose objects are linked in their entirety.

runtime_libs.description: Modules installed alongside at runtime but not linked.

export_shared_lib_headers.description: Shared libs whose headers are re-exported to dependents.

export_static_lib_headers.description: Static libs whose headers are re-exported to dependents.

export_header_lib_headers.description: Header libs whose headers are re-exported to dependents.

export_generated_headers.description: Generated header modules re-exported to dependents.

exclude_static_libs.description: Static libs to exclude from the dependency set.

exclude_shared_libs.description: Shared libs to exclude from the dependency set.

exclude_header_libs.description: Header libs to exclude from the dependency set.

exclude_runtime_libs.description: Runtime libs to exclude from the dependency set.

device_first_generated_headers.description: Generated headers resolved with device-first architecture.

libs.description: Library modules added to the classpath (Java) or dependency set (Python).

associates.description: Kotlin libraries whose internal members are accessible.

plugins.description: Annotation processor or compiler plugin modules.

exported_plugins.description: Annotation processor modules exported to dependents.

hiddenapi_additional_annotations.description: Modules providing additional hidden API annotations.

jni_libs.description: Native libraries to include in APK or APEX.

rustlibs.description: Rust libraries linked as rlib or dylib as appropriate.

tools.description: Host executable modules used as build tools (genrule).

sh_binaries.description: Shell script binary modules to embed (APEX).

certificate.description: Certificate module or name for signing.

enums.description: Properties that accept a fixed set of values. Where values differ by language/context, all valid values are listed with a context note.

c_std.description: C standard version. Empty string uses the build system default.

cpp_std.description: C++ standard version. Empty string uses the build system default.

instruction_set.description: Instruction set for ARM targets. Only meaningful on ARM architectures.

proto.type.description: Protocol buffer generator type. Available values differ by language.

sdk_version.description: SDK version to compile against. Format: [kind_]version. If kind is omitted, 'public' is assumed.

min_sdk_version.description: Minimum SDK version. Same format as sdk_version.

max_sdk_version.description: Maximum SDK version. Same format as sdk_version.

target_sdk_version.description: Target SDK version. Same format as sdk_version.

java_version.description: Java language version for source compilation.

apex_available.description: APEX modules this module may be included in. Accepts specific APEX names or special tokens.
